sources.title: DeepSeek-V4.1 - openlm.ai
sources.snippet: We present DeepSeek-V4 series, including two strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models — DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with 552B parameters (8B / 16B activated) and DeepSeek-V4-Pro with 1.6T parameters (49B activated) — both supporting a context length of one million tokens.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is a 552B multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model for coding, reasoning, visual understanding, and long-context agents, with 8B/16B active parameters and a 1M-token context window.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017: Benchmarks, Pricing and Setup
sources.snippet: Every request to the deepseek-flash model ID now runs on a new checkpoint, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, and nothing in your configuration had to change for that to happen. DeepSeek's change log says the update scores higher across its benchmark set, lifting Terminal-Bench 4.0 from 31.2 to 42.3, while it finishes tasks faster and writes shorter outputs, with the API call and pricing unchanged ...
